Name: Raavi Aggarwal
Bio:
Prof Aggarwal studies the economic impacts of climate change and designs efficient, equitable climate policies. Her work examines carbon pricing effects on household welfare and firm competitiveness in India and other developing countries, as well as policy evaluation for public investment and energy efficiency.

Areas of work:

Carbon pricing and household welfare

Firm competitiveness and climate policy

Cost-benefit analysis of public investment

Energy efficiency policy
Education: PhD, Economic Sciences, Technical University, Berlin | MSc, Economics, University College, London | MA, Economics, Paris School of Economics | BA Hons, Economics, University of Delhi
Research_Interests: Climate change economics | Carbon pricing and decarbonisation | Green industrial policy | Clean energy access | Carbon Pricing | Decarbonisation | Environmental Economics | Development Economics | Public Economics | Climate Policy Design
